question: On the unchanged R3 natural-session pairs, are high compensated responses concentrated in label-blind proxies for gait oscillation, motion blur, low texture, or poor optical flow, and can a response-blind flow-quality gate identify a bounded subset worth further development?

frozen_inputs.source: ADVIO iPhone frames.mov, frames.csv and ground-truth pose.csv already opened by Natural-session expansion Discovery R0
frozen_inputs.r3_ledgers: RCLE_NATURAL_SESSION_EXPANSION_DISCOVERY_R0 runs for the same ordered pair identities

unchanged_algorithm_contract.quality_gate_effect: A rejected pair becomes an abstention and resets the confirmation streak; accepted-pair response values are not changed.

observation_units.inference: No pair-level p-values, confidence intervals, AUROC or F1. Report every session, direction consistency and worst session.

preprocessing.undistortion: same ADVIO iPhone-03 intrinsics, distortion and valid-pixel mask as R3

motion_blur_proxy.metric: mean of previous/current variance of Laplacian over valid pixels
motion_blur_proxy.degraded_stratum: within-session bottom 20 percent with deterministic average ranks
motion_blur_proxy.interpretation: low sharpness proxy only; texture can confound it

low_texture_proxy.metric: Shi-Tomasi detected feature count per valid megapixel in the previous frame
low_texture_proxy.degraded_stratum: within-session bottom 20 percent with deterministic average ranks

gait_oscillation_proxy.metric: maximum of within-session ranks for translation-speed and angular-speed absolute residuals from a centered 31-pair median
gait_oscillation_proxy.interpretation: pose-derived high-frequency head-motion proxy; not an annotated gait phase

high_response.metric: absolute unchanged compensated response among R3-evaluable pairs
high_response.stratum: within-session top 20 percent with deterministic average ranks
high_response.interpretation: descriptive high response, not a risk error label

flow_quality_gate_r0.threshold_basis: Mechanically bounded support: five spatial cells times the existing 12-track cell minimum, at least half of detected tracks forward-backward consistent, subpixel median round-trip error, and at least five of nine grid cells. Thresholds are frozen before extraction and cannot be tuned on response.

descriptive_estimands: within-session high-response prevalence in each degraded proxy stratum versus its complement
within-session risk ratio where denominators are nonzero
fraction of high-response pairs captured by each degraded proxy stratum
overlap of gate rejection with blur, texture and gait proxy strata
fixed-denominator three-pair trigger density before and after gate

requires_all: The fixed gate rejects at least 0.02 and at most 0.30 of pairs in at least three of four sessions.
Gate-rejected pairs have high-response risk ratio at least 1.5 in at least three of four sessions.
Gated three-pair trigger density is at least 20 percent lower than unchanged R3 in at least three of four sessions.
At least one named degradation proxy is enriched among gate-rejected pairs in at least three of four sessions.
No risk labels or sealed-session data were accessed.
decision_rule.interpretation: Passing authorizes only a separately frozen development candidate. It does not show that removed triggers were false or that positive responses were retained.

sensitivity_checks: Report gate results when the median forward-backward threshold is 0.5 px and 1.0 px without changing the R0 terminal.
Report leave-one-session-out direction consistency without fitting thresholds.
Repeat attribution using signed positive response above 0.01/s as an exploratory view while preserving the absolute-response primary definition.
